aboutPreview.title: Professional freight. Personal accountability.
aboutPreview.body: Galan Operations LLC is a U.S. freight and logistics company built around reliability, safety, and a professional fleet culture. We move contracted Amazon Relay work and OTR long-haul routes — and we hire drivers who take pride in showing up.

services.title: Transportation solutions that keep freight moving

amazon.title: Amazon Relay
amazon.summary: Contracted Relay routes with a professional operating standard — consistent work for drivers who are ready to deliver.
amazon.body: Amazon Relay is a contracted freight program that connects qualified carriers with Amazon loads. Galan Operations runs Relay work with a focus on punctuality, clean equipment, and clear communication so freight arrives as promised.
amazon.expectTitle: What drivers and partners can expect
expect: Contracted Relay routes operated to a professional standard
Clear dispatch communication and accountable on-time performance
A culture that treats reliability as non-negotiable

otr.title: OTR Routes
otr.summary: Over-the-road long-haul transportation across U.S. lanes — built for distance, discipline, and trust.
otr.body: Our OTR (Over-The-Road) work covers long-haul lanes across the United States. We keep the brief simple: regular routes, a professional environment, and drivers who treat every mile as a commitment to the customer.
expect: Long-haul routes with a professional dispatch cadence
Emphasis on safety, punctuality, and equipment pride
Room to grow with a company that invests in its people

aboutPage.title: Freight with a standard.
aboutPage.mission: Move freight with discipline and deliver trust on every lane we run. Galan Operations LLC exists to provide professional logistics and transportation solutions across the USA — Amazon Relay contracted routes and OTR long-haul work — while treating drivers as the core of the operation.
aboutPage.vision: A lean, professional carrier that drivers are proud to represent, and that shippers can count on without drama.
aboutPage.story: Galan Operations LLC is a U.S. freight and logistics company. We keep our public story aligned with what we can verify: professional operations, a hiring pipeline for Non-CDL box-truck drivers, and a simple promise — together, we move freight and deliver trust.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.disclaimer: This page is a drafting template for transparency — it is not legal advice. A licensed U.S. attorney should review this policy before it is treated as final.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Galan Operations LLC (“we”) operates this website to describe our freight and logistics services and to receive driver applications and business inquiries.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: If you use the contact or apply forms, we collect the fields you submit: name, email, phone, subject or application details, city/state, license status, work-authorization confirmation, and any message you write. We do not collect document uploads in this version of the site. We also receive standard technical logs (IP address used for rate limiting, user agent) needed to operate and protect the site.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use submitted information only to respond to your inquiry or application, to operate hiring and business communications, and to protect the site against abuse. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We use Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights. These tools are designed to be privacy-respecting and do not rely on third-party advertising cookies. Essential cookies may be used for language preference and session behavior (including whether you have already seen the intro animation).

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep inquiry and application messages only as long as needed to respond and to meet legitimate business or legal recordkeeping needs, then delete or de-identify them. If you want a specific message removed sooner, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold, or to ask how it is used. To make a request, use the contact form or WhatsApp and identify the email/phone you used.

sections.title: Contact for privacy requests
sections.body: Use the contact form (subject: General) or WhatsApp at +1 (689) 253-0469. Do not send government ID images through the website.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.disclaimer: This page is a drafting template — it is not legal advice. A licensed U.S. attorney should review these terms before they are treated as final.

sections.title: Agreement
sections.body: By using this website you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the site.

sections.title: What this site is
sections.body: This website is an informational and hiring presence for Galan Operations LLC. Content describes services and an open Non-CDL driver position. Nothing on this site is a job offer until we explicitly confirm one in writing, and nothing here is professional, legal, or safety advice.

sections.title: Accuracy
sections.body: We work to keep information current, but freight operations, routes, and hiring needs can change. If something matters to a decision — pay, schedule, equipment — confirm it directly with us.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not misuse the forms (spam, automated abuse, false identity), attempt to disrupt the site, or submit content that is unlawful. We may ignore or block abusive submissions.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The Galan Operations name, logo, and site design are owned by Galan Operations LLC or used with permission. You may not copy them for commercial use without written consent.

sections.title: Limitation
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Galan Operations LLC is not liable for damages arising from your use of this website or reliance on its general content. Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations; in those cases, our liability is limited to the maximum permitted by law.
